projection.scope: industry neutrality of incremental TARGET only
projection.numerical_method: Exact Woodbury and positive-definite solves; independent dense oracle; no fitted ridge, floors or pseudo-inverse fallback
projection.interpretation: Minimum Q-weighted distortion of incremental target under B.T*z=0. Q is a risk-plus-impact target distance, not the complete dynamic objective.

common_initial_holdings: accepted fixed512 seed1 pretrade December2015, shared by all5paths
secondary_utility: net population variance utility, descriptive only
unchanged: inherited omission of extra exit liquidation costs

inference.indices: Reuse exact hash-bound40,000 ensemble-screen date streams, never reroll
inference.family_scope: 8 current contrasts plus24 preceding ensemble/adaptive contrasts. Save new family32 intervals for previous contrasts; preserve earlier results.
inference.method: paired stationary circular bootstrap, basic Bonferroni intervals; both lengths required

gate.point: IND source utility strictly exceeds B1,BENS,CENS,AMPL in both periods
gate.primary: all four primary adjusted lower bounds strictly positive at both block lengths
gate.passing_meaning: Exploratory finite-family evidence only; no fresh confirmation or guaranteed future return

limitations: Industry forecasts may contain real return information; removing them can reduce utility.
Target neutrality does not imply industry neutrality after m and inherited holdings.
Style exposures can change through correlated factor loadings.
The Q-norm identity concerns target distance, not actual costs or total portfolio utility.
Conditional inference on saved fitted targets does not account for model re-estimation.
Cumulative finite-family correction does not erase adaptive reuse of previously exposed history.
No changing the utility metric, period, factor subset or statistical method to force a win.
